crm_notes:
Lead source: inbound blog + product signup. SMB, 75 engineers + support ops. Primary product interest: Hosted API (want self-serve).
Use-case details:
- Goal: reduce agent triage time by auto-summarizing incoming tickets + produce structured metadata (category, customer_tier, SLA, suggested_tags).
- Wants deterministic JSON for downstream tool-calls: Zendesk ticket.create, add internal tags, route to L2 when confidence < 0.7.
- Also interested in function/tool calling: call internal webhook to create/update tickets and attach summary.
Performance targets and constraints:
- Latency: aiming for median < 500ms for summary generation at 1-2kb ticket bodies; spikes okay up to 1s for longer threads.
- Throughput: initial POC ~10-20 reqs/sec; expect growth to 50-100 reqs/sec in Q3 if successful.
- Cost sensitivity: high — SMB budget. Wants recommendations for batching and token optimization.
Security/compliance:
- Public cloud acceptable. No SSO/SAML required for POC; audit logs and retention controls desired.
Technical notes from call:
- "We need the JSON to be exactly the schema — if field missing, our webhook fails" — CTO (Eli Navarro).
- Dev team will test with sample 25-ticket prompt set; asked for starter prompt + schema examples.
Next actions assigned:
- Jordan: provision Hosted API trial keys, send quickstart with prompt templates and structured-output examples (by 2026-03-14).
- Priya (SE): prepare small demo app showing tool-calling to Zendesk create_ticket (sample code + cURL).
- Ticket Orchard: PM to confirm POC budget and sign DPA (expected 2026-03-18).
